import os,sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import mkdtemp
from subprocess import run
parent=Path(os.environ['SWARM_PREPARATION_STOP_ORDER_PARENT']).resolve(strict=True)
assert parent.stat().st_uid==os.geteuid() and parent.stat().st_mode&0o077==0
out=Path(mkdtemp(prefix='stop-order-',dir=parent))/'journey'
run([sys.executable,'-B','tests/rust_preparation_web_stop_order.py','--binary',os.environ['SWARM_PREPARATION_UI_BINARY'],'--binary-sha256',os.environ['SWARM_PREPARATION_STOP_ORDER_SHA256'],'--output',str(out),'--minimum-free-bytes',os.environ['SWARM_PREPARATION_STOP_ORDER_RESERVE_BYTES']],check=True)
print('PREPARATION_WEB_STOP_ORDER_EVIDENCE '+str(out))
